notes.title: Minor patch 4.4
notes.content:
- No longer start with a screwdriver (!?)
- Can skip all intro cutscenes with ESC

notes.title: Redemption Fix
notes.content: - Redemption achievement now more achievable (upgraded from nearly impossible to quite tricky)

notes.title: 4.23 - Tiny tweaks
notes.content:
4.23 - Smallest update ever 

- Made 2 hotspots bigger to avoid player having to 'pixel hunt' 
- Altered walkable areas in Piglumps hallway to avoid player triggering headmasters office when on way to your dormitory 
- Found one typo in the 'final showdown' with Grundolph
